purpose: Requirements-management register, not thermodynamic storage schemas, code types, or an implementation API.

obligation_classes.H: Mandatory host behavior wherever its preconditions apply.
obligation_classes.C: Behavior mandatory for a numerical/formulation capability the simulator claims; individual providers may reject unsupported profiles.
obligation_classes.R3: Concrete representability obligation for the four P3 extension scenarios; numerical execution deferred.

requirements.title: Qualify coverage at the scenario and configuration level
requirements.trigger: A capability claim is created, queried, or exported.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Scenario identifier; representation, material set, configuration, operation, physical policy, operating envelope, and evidence records.
requirements.shall: The system shall report Representable, Executable, and Validated evidence separately for the specific claimed configuration and scenario.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A bounded claim with evidence provenance and explicit unassessed dimensions; no library-wide promotion from a method name.
requirements.failure_behavior: An absent execution or validation record leaves the corresponding claim unassessed, not passed.

acceptance_tests.witness: Given only a successful representation walkthrough, querying coverage returns R evidence and no E/V pass.
Given one executed TP example, requesting an E/V claim for a reactive PH unit is rejected as unsupported by that evidence.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Describe the operation actually exposed by an adapter
requirements.trigger: A provider operation is registered or selected.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Exact provider/build/binding identity; exposed operation; supported material/model/phase combinations; derivative and initialization restrictions.
requirements.shall: The system shall qualify the exposed adapter operation rather than inherit the upstream library catalog as its capability statement.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Discoverable supported, unsupported, and unassessed combinations, including any extra host composition needed.
requirements.failure_behavior: Unknown combinations remain unassessed; unsupported combinations do not enter a production solve.

acceptance_tests.witness: A mock adapter exposing TP only reports TP and explicitly unavailable PH even when its upstream description mentions PH.
A solids argument with an explicitly rejecting implementation cannot register a working precipitation capability.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Separate availability from model suitability
requirements.trigger: A configuration is prepared or restored.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Required engine, binding, data, optional modules, and recorded access/availability conditions for the chosen profile.
requirements.shall: The system shall report dependency availability independently of thermodynamic suitability and numerical readiness.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A dependency resolution report identifying missing or restricted resources without substituting another model.
requirements.failure_behavior: An unavailable required dependency blocks the affected operation but does not prevent inspecting its saved definition.

acceptance_tests.witness: A saved model with an absent engine opens for inspection and names the unavailable dependency.
An available wrapper pointing to an absent external engine does not make the calculation executable or satisfy public-dependency coverage.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Admit cohesive packages and qualified submodels
requirements.trigger: An implementation is bound to a thermodynamic configuration.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Declared integration boundary: whole configured package, chemical system, phase/property model, data source, or equation contribution.
requirements.shall: The system shall permit different integration granularities while requiring the same applicable observable request, authority, and outcome semantics.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: An integration declaration identifying which responsibilities are inside the provider and which are supplied by the host.
requirements.failure_behavior: A fragment with no declared completion path cannot be advertised as a complete property-and-equilibrium package.

acceptance_tests.witness: A cohesive external flash service and a host-assembled equivalent both satisfy the same mock request contract without exposing identical internals.
A supplied-K-value phase-allocation utility alone fails qualification as a complete thermodynamic package.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Preserve declared scope and explicit coverage gaps
requirements.trigger: A profile, requirement, or provider assignment is revised.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: B1 scenario/profile baseline; proposed change; coverage and dependency evidence.
requirements.shall: The system shall retain an explicit disposition for every in-scope scenario instead of silently dropping scenarios not served by the selected provider.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Versioned scope status distinguishing targeted, deferred by baseline, unresolved, and explicitly revised commitments.
requirements.failure_behavior: A provider limitation alone is not approval to demote a P2 scenario or claim a P3 numerical capability.

acceptance_tests.witness: Selecting a fluid-only provider leaves SC-21 and SC-31 visible as unresolved coverage obligations.
A change marking SC-31 out of scope without a recorded scope decision fails the coverage review.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Resolve identity without conflating labels
requirements.trigger: A compound or material constituent is selected or mapped.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Authoritative identity or characterization record; aliases and provider identifiers; optional registry identifiers.
requirements.shall: The system shall distinguish material identity from display names, provider names, and numerical position.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A resolved identity or an explicit ambiguity; pseudocomponents need no invented registry identity.
requirements.failure_behavior: Ambiguous aliases require resolution and cannot silently select the first match.

acceptance_tests.witness: Renaming a display label preserves physical identity and all existing balances.
Two provider records sharing an alias do not merge until an explicit identity mapping is supplied.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Declare the material representation and justified operations
requirements.trigger: A material description is created or imported.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Representation kind and basis; species/components/lumps; available molecular, assay, charge, or empirical information.
requirements.shall: The system shall record what a material representation means and qualify operations using only the information it actually supplies.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: An identifiable molecular, apparent-species, compositional-petroleum, reduced-petroleum, or empirical representation with bounded operation support.
requirements.failure_behavior: Unsupported molecular or chemical requests fail specifically without inventing molecular weight, atoms, or critical constants.

acceptance_tests.witness: A mass-only empirical material remains eligible for its supplied heat-capacity calculation.
The same material is refused a molar-fugacity request when no defensible molecular description exists.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Keep intensive state, flow, and inventory distinct
requirements.trigger: A quantity is supplied, converted, or requested.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Quantity meaning, units, amount basis, and any molecular data, density, duration, or reference conditions needed for conversion.
requirements.shall: The system shall convert quantities only through a valid declared basis relationship and shall not treat flow, inventory, and intensive state as interchangeable.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Converted values with their bases and required context; unavailable totals remain unavailable.
requirements.failure_behavior: Missing conversion information produces a missing-basis diagnostic rather than an arbitrary normalization or time interval.

acceptance_tests.witness: A 10 kg inventory and a 2 kg/s stream remain different while mass-to-mole conversion succeeds only when justified.
A total volume without material amount does not yield density; a flow does not become an inventory without a stated operation.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Distinguish zero flow, empty material, and missing composition
requirements.trigger: A zero or near-zero amount/flow is supplied.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Explicit total and component quantities; supplied composition, if any; retention convention; empty-inventory status.
requirements.shall: The system shall preserve the semantic difference between zero flow with a specified composition, undefined composition at zero amounts, and an empty inventory.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Zero extensive quantities with qualified retained intensives or explicit undefined values; no fabricated present phase.
requirements.failure_behavior: No division by zero or arbitrary equal-fraction composition may establish an accepted physical state.

acceptance_tests.witness: Setting flow to zero retains an explicitly specified blend as a reusable specification while reporting zero carried material.
An empty inventory with no composition cannot be reported as a uniquely resolved fluid state.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Replace a complete composition explicitly
requirements.trigger: The caller requests complete composition replacement.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Target material revision; component identities; basis; supplied values; explicit normalization policy.
requirements.shall: The system shall treat complete replacement as replacing the whole declared composition, with unnamed constituents set to zero under that operation.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A new specification with preserved/derived totals identified and the exact normalization, if authorized, recorded.
requirements.failure_behavior: Unknown identities, negative physical fractions, or a missing required normalization choice block acceptance.

acceptance_tests.witness: Replacing A/B/C by A=0.2 and B=0.8 yields C=0 for both newly constructed and loaded materials.
A non-normalized replacement is not silently interpreted as a partial patch or as mole fractions when supplied on a mass basis.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Patch component quantities with a preservation rule
requirements.trigger: The caller edits selected component quantities or rescales a total.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Existing quantities; edited constituents; declared preserve-remaining, preserve-total, or rescale policy and required basis.
requirements.shall: The system shall apply component edits according to the explicitly chosen quantity-preservation policy, independently of creation or load history.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Reconciled totals/compositions and an impact record naming the quantities changed.
requirements.failure_behavior: An underdetermined fraction patch or conflicting total specification is rejected instead of silently changing unmentioned material.

acceptance_tests.witness: For A=2 and B=3 kg/s, patching A to 4 kg/s while preserving B returns total 7 kg/s.
Requesting the same patch while fixing total at 5 kg/s and B at 3 kg/s reports inconsistency rather than accepting all three.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Map composition coordinates consistently
requirements.trigger: Data cross an identity/order/coordinate boundary.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Ordered source and target identities; amount/composition basis; mapping, including phase and derivative coordinates.
requirements.shall: The system shall transform all positional material data consistently with the declared identity and coordinate mapping.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Mapped values and corresponding parameter, residual, and derivative associations with reversible permutation metadata where applicable.
requirements.failure_behavior: Duplicate, missing, or incompatible identities block the affected mapping; coordinates are not inferred from array length.

acceptance_tests.witness: Permuting component order and remapping all inputs reproduces the same labeled properties and balances.
A derivative vector left in the old component order is rejected by the mapping conformance test.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Declare justified conserved quantities
requirements.trigger: A transformation or balance is configured.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Material representation; stoichiometric or empirical balance description; phases; external exchanges.
requirements.shall: The system shall identify the quantities that the selected representation and physical operation justify conserving.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Nonreactive component balances, reactive mass/element/charge balances where defined, or explicitly limited empirical balances.
requirements.failure_behavior: Unknown elemental composition prevents an elemental-closure claim; total molecular moles are not a universal conserved quantity.

acceptance_tests.witness: A molecular reaction is checked on elements and mass while permitting a change in total molecular moles.
An empirical lump without elemental characterization cannot receive a passed carbon-balance result.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Resolve parameter values with provenance
requirements.trigger: Data are selected for an executable configuration.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Source candidates; identities; method and coefficient conventions; units; versions; overrides; stated validity and uncertainty if available.
requirements.shall: The system shall produce an attributable resolved parameter set with explicit source and override precedence.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Actual selected values, model-specific meaning, source/version, and measured/fitted/estimated/user-specified status; unknown quality remains unknown.
requirements.failure_behavior: Conflicting values without a selection policy and incompatible units/conventions prevent readiness.

acceptance_tests.witness: An approved user override wins over a database value and both the selected value and override lineage are recoverable.
A data source with unspecified uncertainty is not automatically labeled validated or high quality.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Interpret missing parameters according to the method
requirements.trigger: A required parameter is absent or a combining rule applies.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Parameter kind; selected model; explicit absence semantics and authorized combining rules.
requirements.shall: The system shall distinguish missing, specified-zero, not-applicable, omitted-interaction, and rule-derived parameters.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A method-specific completeness result and any derived parameter with its derivation.
requirements.failure_behavior: A generic zero default cannot satisfy an unknown required interaction parameter.

acceptance_tests.witness: A permitted pair combining rule yields a derived coefficient while an explicitly supplied zero remains a supplied value.
Removing an essential activity-model pair parameter produces a data gap rather than silently invoking ideal behavior.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Authorize and record estimation or substitution
requirements.initiating_actor: Model author or authorized preparation policy
requirements.trigger: A data gap can be filled only by estimation or an alternate physical description.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Missing values; proposed estimator or substitution; derivation inputs; authorization and applicability policy.
requirements.shall: The system shall create a distinguishable resolved-data revision when an estimation or substitution is accepted.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Qualified values, derivation, authorization, limitations, and requested-versus-used model/data differences.
requirements.failure_behavior: Failed estimation leaves the gap unresolved unless a separately authorized substitute is selected; no hidden near-ideal replacement.

acceptance_tests.witness: An approved group-contribution estimate is recorded as estimated and changes the resolved-data revision.
An estimator failure followed by an unapproved ideal substitution cannot produce ordinary same-model success.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Keep fitted parameter trials separate from approved data
requirements.trigger: A parameter fit is requested or a fitted set is promoted.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Observations and their conventions; fit variables/bounds; objective and weighting; initial values; model recipe; promotion policy.
requirements.shall: When fitting is supported, the system shall retain trial parameter values and fit results separately from approved parameter sets.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A candidate fit with objective/residual evidence, fit domain, parameter values, and explicit approval status.
requirements.failure_behavior: Fit failure or insufficient information cannot modify the approved set or be presented as independent physical validation.

acceptance_tests.witness: A fit changes trial values repeatedly while an unrelated calculation continues to reference its original approved set.
Cancelling a fit does not leave its last iterate installed as the current production parameter set.

requirements.verification_method: Pinned numerical/formulation fixture plus required process integration and negative/boundary tests

requirements.title: Retain characterization inputs and generated materials
requirements.trigger: An assay or engineering material is characterized.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Original assay and conventions; cuts; characterization methods/options; ancillary measurements; approved estimates.
requirements.shall: For supported characterization, the system shall preserve both the original description and the generated constituent/property definitions with derivation lineage.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A reproducible characterized representation and reconciliation against the stated assay quantities.
requirements.failure_behavior: Incomplete assay information or failed reconciliation yields an unresolved/candidate characterization rather than an accepted compositional material.

acceptance_tests.witness: Changing cut boundaries creates a new representation revision while preserving the original assay and prior cuts.
Saving only generated pseudocomponent names without their characterization inputs fails the reconstruction witness.

requirements.verification_method: Pinned numerical/formulation fixture plus required process integration and negative/boundary tests

requirements.title: Prepare and serialize definitions without hidden evaluation effects
requirements.trigger: A definition is inspected, bound to context, or serialized.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Resolved configuration and data revision; requested read/bind/save action.
requirements.shall: The system shall not change approved physical definitions as an implicit effect of ordinary inspection, context association, or serialization.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: The same definition revision before and after the action; internal caches may change only without altering semantic values.
requirements.failure_behavior: Preparation needs encountered during a read/save are reported separately instead of silently fitting or replacing parameters.

acceptance_tests.witness: Saving a configuration with an unresolved data gap preserves that gap and the same parameter revision.
A provider context hook that estimates data is isolated or rejected so it cannot mutate the saved approved definition.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Preserve separate data and model validity information
requirements.trigger: A request is checked against recorded applicability ranges.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Data-fit domain; model applicability; validation envelope; numerical bounds; unknown-range markers; extrapolation policy.
requirements.shall: The system shall report known domain limits separately and apply the configured extrapolation policy without treating convergence as domain validity.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Per-request qualification with inside/outside/unknown assessments and any approved extrapolation.
requirements.failure_behavior: An out-of-policy request is blocked; absent scientific bounds are reported unknown rather than inferred from solver temperature limits.

acceptance_tests.witness: A state inside numerical bounds but outside a fitted-parameter interval is labeled extrapolated when policy permits it.
A converged extrapolated state cannot acquire a within-validation-envelope claim.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Identify a coherent configured package
requirements.trigger: A package configuration is created or changed.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Material representation; compatible phase/property models; data revisions; caloric and standard-state conventions; physical and numerical policy identifiers.
requirements.shall: The system shall identify a configured thermodynamic package by its consequential method, data, and reference choices independently of a runtime session.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A versioned semantic definition with a separately identified provider binding and numerical policy.
requirements.failure_behavior: An EOS/library name alone cannot be treated as a complete reproducible configuration.

acceptance_tests.witness: Two packages using the same EOS but different interaction data or caloric contributions have distinct definitions.
Discarding an ideal caloric contribution while preserving the same complete-package identity fails definition comparison.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Validate composed-method compatibility
requirements.trigger: Methods from one or more providers are assembled.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Phase models; standard states; saturation/Henry conventions; references; caloric contributions; algorithm compatibility evidence.
requirements.shall: The system shall require an explicit compatibility treatment for a composed package before qualifying it for the requested operation.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Qualified combinations, identified unassessed combinations, or a specific incompatibility report.
requirements.failure_behavior: Matching function signatures or unit labels is insufficient to certify thermodynamic consistency.

acceptance_tests.witness: An approved gamma–phi package names the liquid activity standard, vapor treatment, supporting data, and caloric completion.
An activity-coefficient vector connected to an unrelated enthalpy method without convention reconciliation remains unqualified.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Establish operation-specific readiness
requirements.trigger: A unit requests a particular property or state operation.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Required primary/optional properties; material and data; selected methods; algorithm and initializer coverage; process-boundary needs.
requirements.shall: The system shall report readiness for the requested operation rather than use one package-wide ready flag.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A readiness assessment separating representation, data, method, caloric, transport/derivative, algorithm, initialization, and boundary prerequisites.
requirements.failure_behavior: A failed later prerequisite blocks only the affected operation unless it invalidates shared mandatory assumptions.

acceptance_tests.witness: A density-capable package remains usable for density while a PH request reports missing caloric completion.
Successful model construction cannot authorize compressor work when entropy or the actual outlet calculation is unavailable.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Qualify complete caloric behavior before energy-constrained use
requirements.trigger: Enthalpy, entropy, internal energy, or a related inverse calculation is required.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Applicable ideal/residual/excess/correlation contributions; reference conventions; formation treatment; material representation.
requirements.shall: The system shall verify the caloric contributions required by the selected formulation before accepting an energy- or entropy-constrained operation.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A caloric completeness assessment that does not require every provider to use the same mathematical decomposition.
requirements.failure_behavior: Residual-only properties or a generic ideal contribution without justified applicability cannot silently pass as a complete process-energy model.

acceptance_tests.witness: A pseudocomponent package passes PVT readiness but fails PH readiness until its missing caloric contribution is supplied and qualified.
An EOS capable of predicting phase split is not accepted as a validated heater-duty model on that evidence alone.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Separate physical policy from numerical policy
requirements.trigger: Phase, reaction, model, or solver settings are chosen or changed.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Candidate species/phases; participation restrictions; mixing/reference choices; algorithm, tolerances, guesses, and search controls.
requirements.shall: The system shall identify changes to the physical problem separately from changes to the numerical procedure used to solve it.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Distinct physical and numerical policy records, with heuristics and search restrictions qualified by their actual effects.
requirements.failure_behavior: Phase suppression, frozen chemistry, or ideal substitution cannot be recorded only as a convergence-tolerance change.

acceptance_tests.witness: Changing a root solver preserves the physical problem identity while selecting frozen chemistry creates a different physical configuration.
A retry that drops an allowed second liquid cannot retain an unrestricted multiphase success label.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Bind configurations to named material regions and local locations
requirements.trigger: A package is assigned or inherited within a flowsheet.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Region/location identity; explicit assignment or default rule; package revision; component/species compatibility.
requirements.shall: The system shall make the effective thermodynamic binding at each location discoverable and independent of call order or an ambient current-stream pointer.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Resolved bindings and explicit material-boundary checks when neighboring locations differ.
requirements.failure_behavior: An ambiguous inheritance or incompatible assignment blocks the affected calculation rather than choosing the last-used package.

acceptance_tests.witness: Two exchanger sides retain separate discoverable package bindings during interleaved calculations.
Reordering evaluation calls cannot change a stage’s effective package.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Declare candidate domains and phase/species eligibility
requirements.trigger: A physical system or an equilibrium problem is prepared.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Candidate phase/material-domain identities; admitted constituents; phase/reaction transfer restrictions; provider numerical limits.
requirements.shall: The system shall distinguish declared physical candidates, structural candidates required by a formulation, and candidates actually examined by a solver.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Eligibility information usable by numerical and equation-oriented paths, with actual assessed phase scope in results.
requirements.failure_behavior: A missing required candidate or incompatible provider phase count blocks the requested coverage; enumeration alone does not certify stability.

acceptance_tests.witness: A two-liquid problem declares both liquid instances and their admitted constituents independently of product-port labels.
A two-phase-only adapter cannot accept a required vapor–two-liquid problem by ignoring one candidate.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Create a thermodynamic state at any required local location
requirements.trigger: A stream, stage, segment, reactor location, or inventory context requests state information.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Location identity; applicable representation/configuration; available quantities and unresolved variables; caller authority.
requirements.shall: The system shall support local thermodynamic descriptions without requiring a graphical flowsheet stream or a fictitious material flow.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Distinct local state contexts sharing definitions where appropriate, with explicit location and amount semantics.
requirements.failure_behavior: One local evaluation cannot overwrite another location’s specification through shared mutable context.

acceptance_tests.witness: Two column stages share a package but retain different temperature/composition specifications and independent results.
Creating an internal inventory state does not require adding a graphical connector or assigning a dummy flow.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Check specification completeness and consistency
requirements.trigger: A state is submitted for full resolution or retained in a coupled formulation.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Supplied quantities and provenance; declared independent constraints and unknowns; configuration/formulation; requested completion level.
requirements.shall: The system shall distinguish intentionally partial, sufficiently specified, over-specified, inconsistent, and not-yet-assessed state specifications.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A readiness/diagnostic result identifying unresolved or conflicting quantities; redundant compatible observations can be marked as checks rather than extra constraints.
requirements.failure_behavior: Dependent inputs do not establish uniqueness; unresolved numerical rank or feasibility is reported unassessed rather than asserted.

acceptance_tests.witness: A partial stage state remains a legitimate equation-model input but cannot be published as fully resolved.
Supplying mutually inconsistent pressure, temperature, and enthalpy as fixed constraints produces a conflict instead of discarding one silently.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Declare calculation authority per quantity family
requirements.initiating_actor: Unit model, external component, or request validator
requirements.trigger: An operation is requested or an external state is adopted.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Authoritative intensive coordinates, species totals, phase allocation, material amounts, and external exchanges; permitted unknowns/changes.
requirements.shall: The system shall reject an operation whose permitted state changes conflict with the caller’s declared authoritative quantities.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A calculation-authority record distinguishing root/density resolution, phase redistribution, species transformation, and property evaluation.
requirements.failure_behavior: An external allocation cannot be silently re-equilibrated by a property-only request; conflicting authority is an explicit error.

acceptance_tests.witness: A density request resolves its permitted density coordinate while preserving supplied composition, phase amounts, temperature, and pressure.
A request simultaneously fixing an arbitrary phase split and requiring an incompatible unrestricted flash fails authority validation.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Preserve specified values separately from guesses and derived values
requirements.trigger: A local calculation is initialized, updated, or inspected.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: User/process constraints; observations; prior results; numerical guesses; calculated values and their source.
requirements.shall: The system shall retain the role of each value so an initial estimate or previous result cannot silently become an authoritative specification.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Recoverable input intent and separate candidate values; numerical work may revise guesses without changing the physical request.
requirements.failure_behavior: A missing specification cannot be filled from a stale prior result without an explicit choice that changes the request.

acceptance_tests.witness: Changing a column temperature guess leaves the fixed pressure and product specification unchanged.
A stale outlet temperature supplied for initialization is not reported as a user-specified outlet temperature.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Identify phase instances and aggregate views without positional meaning
requirements.trigger: Phase results are received, compared, or routed.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Phase category/domain; composition and amount; provider labels; matching context; aggregate definitions.
requirements.shall: The system shall distinguish physical phase instances from aggregate reporting views and numerical entries, without treating array order as physical identity.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Physical phase identities or an explicit unresolved correspondence; aggregate mixture/liquid views do not increase physical phase count.
requirements.failure_behavior: Near coalescence or ambiguous matching, phase correspondence is reported ambiguous rather than assigning false continuity.

acceptance_tests.witness: Reversing two liquid output entries preserves the labeled physical solution after valid matching.
An overall-liquid aggregate is not published as a third actual liquid phase.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Qualify absent and incipient phase information
requirements.trigger: A phase amount reaches zero or a provider returns placeholder phases.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Phase amount and tolerances; physical presence decision; incipient/stability/initialization information; output role.
requirements.shall: The system shall label zero-amount incipient and numerical phase information separately from properties and compositions of present physical phases.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Explicit presence and information-role status; optional continuation data may be retained without creating material.
requirements.failure_behavior: An absent phase cannot yield an unqualified actual-phase composition or positive product flow from a placeholder.

acceptance_tests.witness: A zero-amount incipient liquid is retained for continuation while total liquid product flow remains zero.
Counting every slot of a two-entry single-phase provider result as a present phase fails result qualification.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Keep flow direction separate from physical composition
requirements.trigger: A flow changes direction or a time-associated state is represented.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Connection orientation; signed transfer convention; nonnegative material amounts/fractions; location and time context if applicable.
requirements.shall: The system shall associate direction with the transfer convention rather than make physical composition fractions or inventories negative.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Direction-qualified transfer values and meaningful physical states at identified locations/time points.
requirements.failure_behavior: Negative accepted physical amounts are invalid; numerical trial coordinates may be nonphysical only when explicitly labeled and confined to the solver.

acceptance_tests.witness: Reversing a connection changes the signed transfer direction but leaves its material’s valid fractions nonnegative.
A negative component fraction cannot be accepted merely because the connection flow is reversed.

requirements.verification_method: Contract inspection plus positive/negative mock or fault-injection tests; actual integration where applicable

requirements.title: Define reporting bases and reference conditions
requirements.trigger: A standard-volume, wet/dry, molality, or phase-fraction quantity is requested.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Observable definition; amount basis and denominator; reference temperature/pressure; carrier/solvent identity; conversion convention.
requirements.shall: The system shall return a reporting quantity only with the basis and reference conditions needed to interpret it.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A labeled derived quantity traceable to physical amounts and the declared convention.

requirements.shall: The system shall use a provider session only with the configuration and context for which its state and caches are valid.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Validated session reuse, reconstruction, or explicit rebinding with recoverable provenance.
requirements.failure_behavior: A reference/parameter/component change invalidates incompatible session reuse; a stale handle is not a current model.

acceptance_tests.witness: Changing a reference convention reconstructs or rebinds affected sessions before the next result is accepted.

requirements.title: Isolate complete calculation sequences across cases

requirements.shall: The system shall prevent one calculation context from changing another’s physical configuration, material state, or diagnostics through shared provider state.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: Isolated outcomes under a declared serial, locked, replicated, or otherwise verified execution policy.
requirements.failure_behavior: Unverified concurrent use is not advertised as supported; internal provider parallelism alone does not establish host reentrancy.

acceptance_tests.witness: Interleaving differently parameterized cases reproduces each serial reference under the chosen isolation policy.
Activating model B between activation and evaluation of model A cannot contaminate A’s accepted result.

requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Original request/configuration; allowed numerical retries; separately authorized physical alternatives; failure reason.

requirements.title: Expose independent result-quality dimensions

requirements.title: Retain result lineage and requested-versus-used assumptions

requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Request and definition revisions; provider/build/binding; actual methods/data; numerical policy; initial/branch context where consequential; substitutions.

requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: An attributable result record with requested-versus-used differences and links to necessary reproducibility inputs.

requirements.title: Distinguish numerical conformance from physical validation
requirements.trigger: A scenario or provider gains evidence or a claim is reviewed.
requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Executed fixture and manifest; predicted outputs; independent reference where available; uncertainty; numerical and model/data tolerances.
requirements.shall: The system shall distinguish adapter/implementation agreement, physical-consistency checks, reference-data agreement, and operational reproducibility evidence.
requirements.outputs_and_postconditions: A validation record bounded by configuration and envelope; absent independent evidence lowers the claim instead of being hidden.

requirements.title: Create a revision and impact assessment for consequential changes

requirements.inputs_and_preconditions: Old and proposed definitions/specifications; dependency relationships or conservative affected-region set; change intent.

requirements.title: Serialize the semantic model and resolved data
